mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the last six months signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the last two months, it signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and RSAFS increase > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with strong demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% over the last month, it signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 150,000 over the last month signal a tightening labor market with strong job growth, which increases wage pressures and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.5% and PAYEMS increase > 150,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
